summary: Rev0341 strengthens the positive evidence path: a sandbox GC-001 bundle now covers the full default selected route set and satisfies strict model-input and authority proof gates, while promotion summaries continue to separate smoke-path success from production finalization.
north_star: Prevent category mistakes in public burdens by routing the real subject, controller, beneficiary, rent, harm, incidence, protected floor, standing, remedy, evidence duty, and review trigger before instrument choice—and prevent internally generated test fixtures from becoming implementation claims.
core_claims: Moral Taxation routes public burdens by real controller, beneficiary, rent, harm, capacity, incidence, protected floor, remedy, evidence duty, and review trigger before instrument choice.
Archive-generated fixtures may test schemas and interfaces but cannot certify implementation-grade evidence.
Externally observed evidence cannot self-certify by writing verified status labels.
External attestations must verify against a configured trust store and fail closed without one.
Rev0341 keeps adapter-binding replay protection and expands the non-certifying signed positive-path harness to strict default-scope proof gates.
Cross-case, cross-route, cross-source, cross-model, and cross-required-output evidence replay is blocked before promotion.
Replay ledgers bind adapter packet hash, adapter binding hash, evidence hash, producer contract hash, truth-boundary hash, verifier status, and result hash.
Promotion recomputes truth-boundary and whole-ledger hashes rather than trusting labels inside the ledger.
All 122 built-in cases remain held because none contains externally observed promotion-eligible evidence.
Non-default route-limit promotion remains blocked outside sandbox mode, and default-scope sandbox success is still separated from final advice.
Sandbox strict positive-path success is reported separately from final promoted cases.
current_limit: The archive now has a strict sandbox evidence bundle that proves verifier, adapter-binding, strict model-input source proof, strict authority-source proof, replay, and promotion mechanics. No built-in record is a production external observation; final promotion still requires trusted external ingress across the active answer scope.
